The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1932–1933''' was contested by 50 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]] won this year's championship by beating [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]], [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]], [[PSV Eindhoven]] and [[Velocitas 1897]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[FC Twente|Enschedese Boys]]
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[VV Sneek Wit Zwart|Sneek Wit Zwart]]
'''Eerste Klasse South:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Zeelandia Middelburg]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[ADO Den Haag]], [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]], [[FC Hilversum]], [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]] and [[ZFC (football club)|ZFC]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[DHC Delft|DHC]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[AFC Ajax]], [[Sparta Rotterdam]], [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]], [[West Frisia (football club)|West Frisia]] and [[KFC (football club)|KFC]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[HFC Haarlem]]
